'''Marc Oliveras Gabarre'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Olivera|Gabarre}} (born 20 December 1991,<ref>{{cite web |url=http://data.fis-ski.com/dynamic/athlete-biography.html?sector=AL&competitorid=127203&type=result&category=ALL&season=ALL&sort=&discipline=ALL&position=&place=&Submit=Search |title=FIS bio |publisher=Data.fis-ski.com |date= |accessdate=2014-02-06}}</ref> in [[Barcelona]]) is an alpine skier who competes for [[Andorra]]. He competed for [[Andorra]] at the [[FIS Alpine World Ski Championships]] in [[FIS Alpine World Ski Championships 2013|2013]] and [[FIS Alpine World Ski Championships 2015|2015]] and competed for [[Andorra]] at the [[Andorra at the 2014 Winter Olympics|2014 Winter Olympics]] and in the [[2015 Winter Universiade]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://m.sochi2014.com/en/athlete-marc-oliveras |title=Sochi 2014 site |publisher=M.sochi2014.com |date= |accessdate=2014-02-06}}</ref>

==Career==
He competed for [[Andorra]] at the [[FIS Alpine World Ski Championships 2013]] in [[Schladming]], [[Italy]]. He finished 27th in the [[FIS Alpine World Ski Championships 2013 – Men's super combined|Super Combined]] and 43rd in the [[FIS Alpine World Ski Championships 2013 – Men's downhill|Downhill]]. He failed to finish in the [[FIS Alpine World Ski Championships 2013 – Men's super-G|Super-G]] and the [[FIS Alpine World Ski Championships 2013 – Men's giant slalom|Giant Slalom]]. He competed for [[Andorra at the 2014 Winter Olympics]]. He finished 34th in the [[Alpine skiing at the 2014 Winter Olympics – Men's super-G|Super-G]], finished 31st in the [[Alpine skiing at the 2014 Winter Olympics – Men's combined|Combined]], finished 38th in the [[Alpine skiing at the 2014 Winter Olympics – Men's giant slalom|Giant Slalom]] and 40th in the [[Alpine skiing at the 2014 Winter Olympics – Men's downhill|Downhill]]. At the [[2015 Winter Universiade]] he won the first medal for the country at the event a silver medal in the [[Alpine skiing at the 2015 Winter Universiade – Men's super-G|Super-G]].
